ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-02: Quote cannot be Accepted while Finance Approval Status is Pending or Rejected. First quote on an account with Account Finance Approved is bypassed (BOSS parity).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Accepted"), ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Rejected")), NOT(OR( ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Status__c, "Not Required") )), NOT(AND( OR(ISBLANK(Opportunity.Account.Active_Quote_Count__c), Opportunity.Account.Active_Quote_Count__c <= 1), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.Account.Finance_Approval_Phase__c, "Approved") )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Finance Approval is Pending or Rejected. Finance must approve this Quote before it can be Accepted.
